core_obligations: Choose a Deligne system representing K, show that both sides restrict to the constant pro-object with value Rg_*K, and reduce by uniqueness to proving that (Rf_*K_n) is pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system (proof lines 8488-8502).
Reduce the claim to a single coherent module by independence of the choice of the system and the 2-out-of-3 property along truncation triangles (proof lines 8504-8516).
Localise on Y, translate into an algebraic statement about the inverse systems (H^p(X, I^n F)) and (I^n M), and conclude with the cohomology of powers of an ideal lemma (proof lines 8518-8533).
proof_roadmap: The pro-object reduction by uniqueness of Deligne systems (proof lines 8488-8502).
Reduction to one coherent module (proof lines 8504-8516).
The cohomology of powers of an ideal (proof lines 8526-8533).
difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y of Noetherian schemes, an open V of Y with U = f^{-1}(V) and the cartesian square relating them, the lemma asserts a canonical isomorphism Rj'_! o Rg_* -> Rf_* o Rj_! of functors D^b_Coh(O_U) -> Pro-D^b_Coh(O_Y), where the extension functors are those of Remark labelled remark-extension-by-zero (statement lines 8471-8486). For K in D^b_Coh(O_U) the proof takes a Deligne system (K_n) for U -> X whose restriction is constant with value K, representing Rj_!K in the pro category, observes that both Rj'_!Rg_*K and Rf_*Rj_!K restrict to the constant pro-object with value Rg_*K on V, the second because (Rf_*K_n)|_V = Rg_*(K_n|_U) = Rg_*K, and concludes by the uniqueness of Deligne systems in Lemma labelled lemma-extension-by-zero that it suffices to show that (Rf_*K_n) is pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system, which also gives functoriality (proof lines 8488-8502). The second paragraph shows this: the question is independent of the choice of (K_n) by the same uniqueness, and Lemmas labelled lemma-extension-by-zero-triangle and lemma-deligne-system-2-out-of-3 make the property a 2-out-of-3 property along distinguished triangles, so the truncation triangles of Derived Categories, Remark labelled derived-remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle reduce to a single coherent O_X-module F (proof lines 8504-8516). Writing J for an ideal cutting out Y minus V and J^n F for the image of f^*J^n otimes F -> F, the proof must show that (Rf_*(J^n F)) is a Deligne system; by Lemma labelled lemma-characterize-extension-by-zero the question is local on Y, so one takes Y = Spec(A) affine with J corresponding to an ideal I, and by Lemma labelled lemma-characterize-extension-by-zero-algebra it suffices to show that the inverse system (H^p(X, I^n F)) is pro-isomorphic to (I^n M) for some finite A-module M, which is Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma labelled coherent-lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-application (proof lines 8518-8533). Reducing the statement to a local algebra question about powers of an ideal in cohomology, via the uniqueness of Deligne systems and the 2-out-of-3 property, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
